The Global-e team is made up of a diverse range of people, from many cultures and many different professional backgrounds, who bring creativity, skill and hard work to the table every day.


We encourage individual thinking as well as teamwork, and create inclusive environments where innovative ideas flourish.
Our growing success is all down to our people. Thanks to their passion and commitment we push the boundaries and help our clients expand their brand worldwide and accelerate their growth.

The Global-e Way

Responsibility
Teamwork
Cultivating
Growth
Can-do
mindset
Equality in
Opportunities

We embrace responsibility at every level, taking ownership of our projects and actions both individually and as a team. With a commitment to consistently delivering excellent outcomes, we embrace a culture of personal accountability.

Collaboration isn’t just integral to our culture; it’s at our core. Working closely together within our teams and across departments is the key to building the world’s leading global e-commerce platform and driving continued success for our clients.

Whether through self-driven learning or collaborative knowledge-sharing, we cultivate an environment of continuous professional and personal development, empowering ourselves to sharpen our skills and fuel our team members’ growth.

By embracing challenges as opportunities, we go beyond problem-solving, believing that no obstacle is too big and no problem is beyond resolution. This mindset drives a culture of continuous advancement, innovation, and out-of-the-box thinking, propelling us to exceed expectations at every turn.

We believe everyone should have an equal chance to pursue success, thrive, and strive for excellence. Our commitment to equality in opportunities is reinforced by the diverse perspectives and experiences within our team, driving us to be our best.
